missing_features.description: Migrate existing employee records and leave balances into the new System to ensure availability from day one.
missing_features.name: Data Migration
missing_features.reason: TOR requires complete employee records and current leave balances to be available from the first day of live operation (ST-a9f40f94ca, page 3), but no data migration feature is in the backlog.

missing_features.description: Maintain reference data such as leave types, organisation structure elements, and document types to support system configuration and business rules.
missing_features.name: Reference Data Maintenance
missing_features.reason: TOR requires HR staff to maintain organisation structure, leave types and policies, and holiday calendar (ST-49f2d8b0bf, ST-81104420ce, ST-79d7816ff6, pages 3-4), but no explicit reference data maintenance feature is in the backlog beyond organisation structure and leave types; a dedicated reference data maintenance feature is implied for completeness.

missing_features.description: Provide HR managers with a screen to search and view audit trail records of all create, update, delete, approval and login actions.
missing_features.name: Audit Trail Viewer
missing_features.reason: TOR requires audit trail recording and search by HR managers (ST-1fdc2c7aea, ST-ffeb549ae7, page 8), but only an audit trail feature is listed without explicit mention of a viewer screen in the backlog.

missing_features.description: Allow system administrators to create, deactivate, reset user accounts and assign roles and branches through user-friendly administration screens.
missing_features.name: User Administration Screens
missing_features.reason: TOR requires user administration by system administrators (ST-42397c721f, page 8), and while a user administration feature is in the backlog, it is not explicitly described as screens; explicit user administration screens are a common precedent and checklist item.

missing_features.description: Send email notifications for request submissions, approvals, rejections, returns, reminders to approvers and HR staff for expiring documents.
missing_features.name: Notifications Framework
missing_features.reason: TOR requires email notifications for workflow state changes and reminders (ST-a27625351d, ST-7773947562, page 8), and while a notifications feature is in the backlog, a notifications framework is a common cross-cutting feature to support all notification needs and is implied by the TOR.

notes: Backlog covers most functional modules and workflows described in the TOR.
Integration with payroll system is well covered in the backlog.
Role-based access and user administration are included but user administration screens need confirmation.
Notifications and audit trail features exist but need confirmation on viewer and framework completeness.
questions: What is the source and volume of historical employee and leave data to be migrated?
Does the client prefer local authentication or SSO for login, given the Foundation epic covers authentication?
Is the existing audit trail viewer functionality sufficient or is a new dedicated audit trail screen required?
